name: elearning-platform
description: EduAI E-Learning Platform — React + Node.js + MongoDB + Razorpay

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.start:dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Root installed. Run npm run install:all for full setup.'
